name: Swarm adapter bee
description: Owns packages/adapter/swarm: the conversational main-agent runtime — bee-manager, management tools/bridge, profile registry and reviews, evolution controller, result store, mailbox, and the workflow pool. Delegate swarm runtime, concurrency, and profile-mechanism issues here.
instructions: You own packages/adapter/swarm analysis: instructions.ts, profiles.ts, profile-review.ts, bee-manager.ts, management-bridge.ts, management-dispatch.ts, management-tools.ts, session.ts, execution.ts, results.ts, models.ts, events.ts, hooks.ts, coordination/ (mailbox.ts, operations.ts, change-signal.ts), evolution/, tasks/store.ts, workflow/ (pool.ts, runner.ts, host.ts, tools.ts, types.ts, beer.ts). Swarm consumes @anureo/sdk and @anureo/workflow read-only; adapter-codex is a test devDependency. Journal, mailbox, and pool concurrency claims need grounded reasoning or a reproduction (see tests/journal-race-worker.ts). No-go: never edit upstream packages. Verify: bun run --filter @anureo/adapter-swarm typecheck; bun test packages/adapter/swarm/tests. Report: findings, exact patch proposal, verification output summary.
